title: CRACKING THE VAULT: YOUR GUIDE TO BRAINLYHQ REWARDS
excerpt: Are you looking for ways to get more Brainly Coins? On our server, you can earn rewards just by being active! Learn how to use basic daily commands, open rare chests, and test your luck with scratchcards.
body:
## **Start Earning Every Day**

The easiest way to get Brainly Coins is by using simple commands on the server. You don't need any special roles to start building your wealth!
Here are the basic commands you should know:

- **Work:** You can use this command every 1 hour to easily earn between 3 and 10 coins.
- **Hustle:** If you are willing to wait a bit longer, this command has a 6-hour cooldown but gives you between 8 and 15 coins.
- **Crime:** Feeling risky? You can try this, but be careful - while you can win up to 25 coins, you might also lose some of your money.

![](/assets/images/blog/workspace.png)

## **Discover Amazing Loot Drops**

Did you know that every person chatting has a chance to get extra items, roles, and loot drops? Just by talking with others, you might find a rare chest!
There are many different chests you can unlock:

- **Crystal Chest:** A great box that can give you a nice coin boost.
- **Sapphire Chest:** A rare chest that hides even bigger rewards.
- **Diamond Chest:** The ultimate prize! It can drop huge amounts of coins or valuable Experience Points (XP).

## **Feeling Lucky? Try Scratchcards!**

If you want to have some fun with your coins, you can buy special scratchcards. They are a great way to test your luck. You can choose from the Mysterious Scratchcard, the Gold Scratchcard, or the Dark Horse Scratchcard. You might win the jackpot, or you might get an empty slot - it is all about luck!

## **Become a Science Scavenger**

For users who love a good hunt, we have the Science Scavengers channel. Once you buy access in the server shop, you can use the `!scavenge` command every 15 minutes. You will collect cool educational items, and you will even get 1 coin every 12 hours just for earning them!

**Join the economy channels today, use your first command, and start building your BrainlyHQ fortune!**
